name: Kbd
description:
A keyboard shortcut, formatted for the viewer's platform: ⌘K on macOS, Ctrl K elsewhere.
The text is announced in its platform form; `aria-keyshortcuts` belongs on the control
the shortcut triggers, not here.
signature: ({ keys, variant, size, className, ...rest }: KbdProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: keys
props.description: A shortcut such as "mod+k", "mod+shift+r", "shift+f10" or a single key ("esc").

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`keys` draws keycaps (help text, palette hints). `text` is the quiet inline form used
at the trailing edge of menu and palette rows.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
